Within 15 days from the date of publication of the advertisement

content_sections.heading: About Sahayog Sevabhavi Sanstha College of Education
content_sections.text: Sahayog Sevabhavi Sanstha College of Education is a college of education at Vishnupuri, Nanded, described in the notice as Permanent Non-Granted. The notice offers the M.Ed. and B.Ed. faculty posts listed here, and the application form is on the website of Swami Ramanand Teerth Marathwada University, Nanded (srtmun.ac.in).

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists 1 Professor, 1 Associate Professor and 9 Assistant Professor posts, all of regular nature. The 9 Assistant Professor posts carry the category break-up below, which adds up to 9. As per the Government Decision dated 25.01.2024, parallel reservation in recruitment will be strictly implemented. The parallel reservation printed is: Assistant Professor Female 05, Divyang 01, Sportsperson 01. The notice also states 3% reservation for handicapped and 30% for women candidates.

rows.reservation: OPEN 02, ST 01, NT(B) 01, NT(C) 01, OBC 02, SEBC 01, EWS 01

rows.post: Assistant Professor Pedagogy Subjects (Math, Science, Social Science, Language)

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The notice states that qualifications are as per UGC and NCTE. Each post's requirement as printed: The notice prints no age limit. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.qualification: An eminent scholar with a Ph.D. in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline and published work of high quality; actively engaged in research, with a minimum of 10 research publications in peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120 as per Appendix II, Table 2.
rows.experience: Minimum ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor/Principal, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institution, with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidates.

rows.qualification: A good academic record with a Ph.D. in the concerned/allied/relevant disciplines; and a Master's Degree with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed).
rows.experience: Minimum eight years of teaching and/or research experience in a position equivalent to Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry, with a minimum of seven publications in peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 75 as per Appendix II, Table 2.

rows.qualification: Post Graduate degree in Social Sciences with minimum 55% marks and M.Ed. from a recognized university with minimum 55% marks; OR Post Graduate (M.A.) degree in Education with minimum 55% marks, B.Ed/B.El.Ed with minimum 55% marks, and SET/NET/Ph.D. in Education.

rows.post: Assistant Professor Pedagogy Subjects (Math, Science, Social Science, Language)
rows.qualification: Postgraduate degree in Sciences/Mathematics/Social Sciences/Languages with minimum 55% marks; M.Ed. with minimum 55% marks; and SET/NET/Ph.D. in Education.
Master of Physical Education (M.P.Ed.) with minimum 55% marks; and SET/NET/Ph.D. in Physical Education.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Pay: pay scale as per UGC, NCTE, State Government and Swami Ramanand Teerth Marathwada University, Nanded rules from time to time. No amount is printed. Nature of all posts: Regular. No T.A./D.A. will be paid to attend the interview.

content_sections.text: Get the prescribed application form from the University website: srtmun.ac.in. Attach all attested Xerox copies of certificates and other relevant documents to the application form. Send the application by registered post to: Sahayog Sevabhavi Sanastha College of Education, Vishnupuri, Nanded - 431606. Candidates already in service should submit the application through proper channel. The notice gives the email [email protected] under the address for correspondence.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the Sahayog Sevabhavi Sanstha College of Education recruitment?
faq.answer: The notice prints 1 Professor, 1 Associate Professor and 9 Assistant Professor posts, a total of 11, all regular.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted within 15 days from the date of publication of the advertisement. The notice prints no publication date.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply?
faq.answer: Send the application with all necessary documents by registered post only to Sahayog Sevabhavi Sanastha College of Education, Vishnupuri, Nanded - 431606.

faq.question: Q4. Where can I get the application form?
faq.answer: The prescribed application form is available on the University website, srtmun.ac.in.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for the Professor post?
faq.answer: A Ph.D. in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, a minimum of 10 research publications and a research score of 120, plus a minimum of ten years of teaching and/or research experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification for Assistant Professor Health & Physical Education?
faq.answer: Master of Physical Education (M.P.Ed.) with minimum 55% marks, and SET/NET/Ph.D. in Physical Education.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: Pay scale as per UGC, NCTE, State Government and Swami Ramanand Teerth Marathwada University, Nanded rules from time to time. No amount is printed.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates already in service apply?
faq.answer: Yes. Those already in service should submit their application through proper channel.

faq.question: Q9. Will travel allowance be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no T.A./D.A. will be paid to attend the interview.

faq.question: Q10. What reservation is mentioned?
faq.answer: The notice states 3% reservation for handicapped and 30% for women candidates. Parallel reservation is Assistant Professor Female 05, Divyang 01 and Sportsperson 01.
